title: Thai Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired curry made with tender chicken and a rich coconut milk sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and brown sugar, if using.
Stir in the cilantro and serve over rice or noodles.
